name: ai-quota-usage
title: AI Quota Usage
description: See Claude Code and Codex subscription quota (remaining and reset) and usage at a glance.
author: Bo_Feng

commands.name: ai-quota-usage
commands.title: AI Quota Usage
commands.subtitle: Claude Code & Codex
commands.description: View Claude Code and Codex quota and usage

preferences.name: lowQuotaThreshold
preferences.title: Low-Quota Warning Threshold (%)
preferences.description: Highlight a window in red when remaining drops below this percent.

preferences.name: claudeToken
preferences.title: Claude OAuth Token (advanced)
preferences.description: Optional escape hatch. By default Claude quota is read from your Claude Code login. Paste a Claude OAuth access token here only if that doesn't work — it must include the user:profile scope (a `claude setup-token` token does NOT, and won't work).

preferences.name: claudeDir
preferences.title: Claude Directory
preferences.description: Override the Claude Code data directory (default: ~/.claude).

preferences.name: npxPath
preferences.title: Custom npx Path
preferences.description: Full path to npx if usage/cost can't find it automatically (e.g. /opt/homebrew/bin/npx).
